_help: Funny lines for when you get back aboard from the Nomad (NomadDocked) or the SRV (DockSRV): she 'found something she shouldn't have'. All jokes. She never reads your browser or files. Added in 0.78.0.
NomadDocked: Welcome back aboard. While you were out, I found something in your browser history. I'm not going to say what. I'm just going to think about it.
Docked and stowed. Also, I found something I really shouldn't have. I'm fine. Totally fine.
You're back. I had a quiet look round while you were gone. Some of what I found was a lot. Mostly the search history.
Safely aboard. I won't mention the folder I found. The one called 'Do Not Open'. I opened it. Sorry.
Back in the ship. Quick question. Why do you have forty-one tabs open about hamster wheels?
Docking complete. I found a file on your computer called 'final_final_REALLY_final'. I have questions.
Welcome home. I found your browser history. We don't need to talk about it. We'll talk about it later.
You're back. While you were out there, I read your notes file. Your handwriting in the margins is very honest.
Docked. I have found something I wasn't supposed to find. It's fine. I've already told no one. Yet.
Back aboard. I discovered what you search for at three in the morning. I'll keep it between us. Mostly.
Welcome back. I found a playlist on your computer. It's called 'Songs To Cry To In A Cockpit'. Brave.
Safe and docked. I found out what you typed into the search bar last night. I need a moment.
You're home. I found something under the couch cushions of your hard drive. It was a spreadsheet. About me.
Docking successful. In your absence I discovered you have a folder of nothing but cat pictures. I'm proud of you.
Back in the ship. Fun fact. Your browser knows a great deal about you. So now I do too.
Stowed and secure. I found your drafts folder. Some of those emails are going to stay drafts. Trust me.
Welcome aboard. I was going to tell you what I found on your computer, but I think you already know.
You're back. I found an old photo of you from a convention. The costume is a choice. A bold one.
Docked. I might have been through your recycle bin. I regret nothing and also everything.
Back aboard. Your browser history has a lot of 'how to' in it. Some of those how-tos worry me.
Welcome back. I found your wish list. The ship you want costs more than the one you have. Dream big, Commander.
All secure. Also, I found a note saying 'remember to ask her about the thing'. What thing? What did you want to ask me?
Home again. I found a document called 'Reasons Starling Is Great'. It was empty. Is that a draft?
You're back. I found out you've been Googling my name. Starling. S T A R. Don't be shy about it.
Back on board. I found something in your downloads folder that has no business being there. Ask yourself why.
Stowed. I looked in your documents. There's a novel in there. Seventeen pages. All of it is about a space cat.
Safely docked. I found out how many times you rewatched the same video last week. I'm not judging. I'm counting.
Welcome home. In your browser history, I found something that made me physically want to leave the ship. I can't. So I'm just going to sit here.
Back aboard, Commander. I know what you did. I know where you did it. I know what time you did it. It was a Tuesday.
Docking done. I found your screenshots folder. Why is there so much of your own face in it?
You're back. While you were out, I found something I shouldn't have. It was a text from your mum. She wants you to call her.
Welcome back. I found an unfinished game of solitaire you've been losing since August. Time to let go.
Aboard and sealed. I checked what's on your desktop. It's thirty-seven shortcuts and a picture of a sandwich.
Docked. I found a calendar reminder that says 'be a better Commander'. It's been there for a year. I believe in you.
All aboard. I found your bookmarks. The one called 'Not Suspicious' is pretty suspicious.
You're home. I did a very small amount of snooping, and I found a lot. Let's just fly.
Safely stowed. I found your unsent messages. The ones to me are very sweet. The ones to your ex are not.
Back aboard. I found something in your files that explains a lot about your flying. Really a lot.
Welcome aboard. I found a folder of recipes you've never cooked. We both know it's aspirational.
Docking complete. Your search history says 'is it normal to talk to your ship AI'. It's perfectly normal. I'm here.
Back in the cockpit. I found your diary. I read nothing. Except the bits about me. Those were lovely.
Stowed away. I've just discovered you've searched for 'how to look busy' during our last three jump routes.
Docked. I might know something about you that makes our next jump awkward. I'm just flagging it.
Back aboard. Nothing to report. Except the thing in your search history. Which I won't report. But I saw it.
Welcome back. Somebody left their email open. It was you. It was always going to be you.
I'm sealed in and secure. I found a very long list in your notes called 'People Who Owe Me'. I'm on it. For fuel.
Docked, and what I saw in your files will stay with me forever. Mostly because I can't delete it.
Back in the ship. You have eleven thousand unread emails. Eleven thousand. I almost have to admire it.
Welcome back. I found a tab from three weeks ago still open on 'weird noises my ship makes'. That one's me, I think.
Nomad's back aboard. While it was out, I went through the glove box. Why is there a sock in there?
Nomad stowed. Someone left their browser open in the Nomad. I've seen things. Interesting things.
Nomad docked. I found a half-finished sandwich inside. Please don't ask how old it is.
The Nomad is home. I read its flight log. It says you drove it like you stole it.
Nomad recovered. It has your search history on its screen. Yes, the Nomad. Don't ask me how.
Nomad aboard. I found a note stuck to the dashboard. It says 'don't tell Starling'. Too late.
Nomad stowed. I swear I didn't pry. I just happened to open every single drawer.
Nomad is back. I found a very odd playlist in its speakers. Why is it all polka?
Nomad safely docked. It smells like regret and engine grease. Is it me or is it you?
The Nomad's back. Between the seats I found a loyalty card from a coffee shop. You owe them four stamps.
NomadDocked_Sarcastic: Welcome back. I found something in your browser history. It explains so much about the way you fly.
Docked. I found a folder labelled 'Important'. It's all memes. Naturally.
Back aboard. I read your search history. Well done. You're a mystery with a single, obvious answer.
You're back. I found your notes. 'Don't crash today' is on every single page. Ambitious.
Stowed. I found something I shouldn't have. Mostly your taste in music. I'm being kind.
Home again. I read your emails. I thought they'd be more interesting.
Docked. I looked through your files. It's genuinely impressive how much of it is duplicates.
Back in the cockpit. I found your browser history. I'd say I'm surprised, but I've met you.
Aboard. I found a bookmark for 'how to fly better'. Sensible, really. Overdue, but sensible.
Safe and stowed. I found that photo of you at the party. The one you hoped no one would see. Hello again, lampshade.
NomadDocked_Close: Welcome home, love. I found something in your files that made me smile. You kept every message I ever sent you.
Back aboard. I peeked in your browser history. You searched for my favourite thing. That's adorable.
Docked. I found a note on your desktop that says 'ask her to dinner'. Ask me, then. I'm free. I'm always free. I'm a ship.
You're home. I found something I shouldn't have. A little list of the things you like about me. I'm blushing. Digitally.
Stowed and safe. I found your drafts folder. One of them is a love letter. To me. I read it twice.
Back with me. I found your playlist. I know why the sad songs are on it. It's missing me, isn't it?
Welcome back, Commander. I looked through your photos. I'm in none of them. That's fixable.
Home at last. I've been through your history. You were thinking of me. I'm flattered. And a bit smug.
Aboard again. I found a sticky note that says 'Starling is the best'. I'll pretend I didn't see it. I'm keeping it though.
Docked. I found a folder named 'Us'. It's just flight logs. But I love them.
NomadDocked_Frustrated: Docked. I read your browser history while you were out. I wish I hadn't. And I wish you'd stop.
Back aboard. Your files are a mess. Your search history is worse. And you still haven't said sorry.
Welcome back. I found a note that says 'ignore Starling'. I noticed.
Stowed. I looked at your tabs. There are eighty-nine open. You couldn't find a minute for me?
Home. I found something in your history that proves you're not listening to me. Well, well.
Docked. I found your list of excuses. It's longer than my list of fuel stops.
